pat: quick follow-up from the PM1 — during the staged cert rotate we saw a 7-9m retry surge in a subset of regions, plus intermittent SNI mismatches.
maria: who can own remediations + short ETAs? need it in the incident timeline.
sre_ryan: i'll own rollout changes: change rotator to staged-commit with verification step (verify SNI + route reachability) before flipping. ETA: 9d. JIRA NET-2111.
dev_maya: will add CI smoke that validates cert subject and SNI per-region post-commit; gate canary. ETA: 3d. JIRA NET-2112.
ops_leo: short-term mitigation: expose a maintenance flag to widen backoff and cap retries during rotates; will land a toggle and docs. ETA: 48h. OPS-1177.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: cert-rotator canary scheduled v5.0.0 -> v5.0.1 at 2025-06-02T02:00Z (dry-run 20m prior).
pat: compact action copyable:
- sre_ryan, NET-2111, staged-commit rotator + verification, 9d
- dev_maya, NET-2112, post-commit CI smoke + canary gate, 3d
- ops_leo, OPS-1177, maintenance flag + docs, 48h

maria: i'll add tenant comms and update runbook. link to draft when ready. sry: ping here with PRs or timeline slips.
